text.description_html:
First Impressions SD-WST100SMTSS4, Satin Stainless Steel Glass Door Pull Set

The clean lines of this pull make it a very popular choice for glass doors both for showers, but also as pulls on store front glass doors. The 1 Inch Diameter Stainless Wasatch Pull has a satin stainless steel finish. Choose from 12 inch, 24 inch, or 36 inch lengths. This Modern Stainless Steel Door Pull comes with everything you'll need to install it on a 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch thick glass door.

Specifications for the First Impressions Stainless Steel Glass Door Pull:

  • Pull Handle Material: Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with 2 door pulls, 4 decorative rosettes plus mounting hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass doors.
  • First Impressions SD-WST100SMTSS4 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Available in 3 Sizes:

    SD-WST100012SMTSS4:
    • Total Length: 12"
    • Center to Center Mount: 8"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
    • Total Projection: 2-1/2"
    • Clearance: 1-1/2"

    SD-WST100024SMTSS4:
    • Total Length: 24"
    • Center to Center Mount: 18"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
    • Total Projection: 2-1/2"
    • Clearance: 1-1/2"

    SD-WST100036SMTSS4:
    • Total Length: 36"
    • Center to Center Mount: 24"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
    • Total Projection: 2-1/2"
    • Clearance: 1-1/2"

Note: These stainless steel glass door pulls are handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 7 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
